rule: Every figure on valorftc.ai/info/ is read from the desk (GET, token header) at publish time by tools/publish_info.py, or read from a named repo file; the source of each value is listed beside it under values. Nothing is estimated: a figure the desk cannot supply is rendered as an em dash titled 'not reported' or left out and listed under left_out. Timestamps are Pacific. Relative-time clauses in systems-check text ('N ago', 'expires in', 'today', 'weekend', 'market closed') are removed before rendering. Every sentence on the page that is the owner's policy rather than a reading carries a visible '(policy)' marker and is listed under policy_statements with its template line; the generator fails if the markers and the list disagree. Figures that are derived (a ratio of two readings) say so in their source. The desk funnel counts only run records of kind 'backtest'; SVT sweep backtests are counted in the sweep panel.

svt_note.value: TRUE walk-forward with purged embargo: in each of 5 windows the best IN-SAMPLE config is selected and only its out-of-sample segment is scored - the ranking number never picks itself. Sharpe is excess-of-cash at the asset's own clock (365-day for crypto); costs come from config/tqd.yaml - liquidity-tiered 2-30bp equity sides, 32.5bp crypto sides (venue-true) - with borrow on shorts. This sweep IS multiple testing: with 2560 trials, luck alone produces impressive best cases (I01); survivors are candidates for pre-registration, not conclusions.
